notes.title: 1.0 UPDATE is OUT!
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44969870/01be711c39931392210e6ff22540dfa6cc9bb355.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Greetings Heroes![/h2][p][/p][p]Today we are releasing our 1.0 Update which signals the end of Early Access for Evercore Heroes: Ascension.[/p][p][/p][p]This will be our last update to the game with no more further updates or new content to follow. We worked our hardest to add as much from our backlog into this 1.0 release as we could![/p][p][/p][p]Let's dive in![/p][p][/p][h3][b]New hero: Grayce![/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Being both graceful as deadly - Grayce, our very own take on a dancer killer robot has been let loose as our newest damage dealing hero![/p][p][/p][p]As the name suggests, she excels at dealing a lot of damage but does so gracefully! Twirling, swirling and dancing elegantly she'll dispose of all that stand in her way while giving them the performance of their lives![/p][p][/p][p]She's all about using a lot of abilities in swift succession. When her abilities meet certain expectation, she'll be allowed to use them again without additional cost like an encore to her performance! Perform enough of them and you'll be able to stun your enemies with your dashing moves! This gives Grayce the ability to dance across the battlefield and dealing tons of damage.. but only if you do it right! [/p][p][/p][p]One wrong move and the curtain will fall![/p][p][/p][p][i]1.. 2.. 3...[/i] [b]Step![/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44969870/ca9b17a700db07072a04f7df7525a364abf04493.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Grayce will be available to unlock with in-game currency just like Ace Everstar was on release.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Change to multiplayer[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]With the game no longer being in development we unfortunately have to limit certain online systems and you'll no longer be able to use matchmaking or play multiplayer.[/p][p][/p][p]All your progress and (future) unlocks will however stay intact! You can keep going for runs and unlocking content just like before![/p][p][/p][p]We've worked on making balance changes that'll make solo play more enjoyable no matter which hero you like to play! You can read more about these changes down below in the patch notes! [/p][p][/p][h3][b]Hero skins are back![/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44969870/b34dd71990742f5be8a6a429ec42a999f8bff7d4.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Play in style and claim your pack of amazing hero skins [b]FOR FREE![/b][/p][p][/p][p]You can claim your pack of hero skins in Castle Averae by interacting with Ace's magical mirror on the top right of the castle! Once claimed, you can change the skin of your hero in the same place you also select your hero![/p][p][/p][p]There is a skin for every hero in the game so whoever you prefer to play - there will be a skin for you![/p][p][/p][h2][b]PATCH NOTES[/b][/h2][p][/p][p][b]\[New content][/b][/p][p]Grayce - the new dancing DPS hero is now available![/p][p][/p][p][b]\[1.0 Balance Changes][/b][/p][list][*][p]Dash has been reduced to 3 second cooldown for all players.  The Soulbound Bloom Dash Cooldown now reduces Dash to 1.5 second cooldown.[/p][/*][*][p]Small and Medium Luum pickups have had their values increased slightly[/p][/*][*][p]Most enemy health values have been reduced, especially larger enemies, to make the game faster paced[/p][/*][/list][p]Beko[/p][list][*][p]Increased Basic Attack damage and his bonus effectiveness. Little guy hits hard![/p][/*][*][p]Increased the duration of the Stun on the Lantern explosion spell. Minor stun is now 1 second, and major stun is now 4 seconds[/p][/*][/list][p]Riiva[/p][list][*][p]Weapon Throw and Smash Damage have been tuned up[/p][/*][*][p]Riiva now has a Critical strike chance of 2% on all Basic Attacks[/p][/*][*][p]Health has been increased to 150 base[/p][/*][/list][p]Shade[/p][list][*][p]The Critical Strike chance after Blink has been increased to 30%.[/p][/*][/list][p]Fyn[/p][list][*][p]Health has been increased to 120 base[/p][/*][*][p]Basic Attack and Charge damage have been increased[/p][/*][*][p]The Stun duration of Shield Toss has been increased[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][i]~Vela Games[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44969870/e474d036876e1fba0062b89b2b803fca9356181e.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: 1.0 Release Announcement
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44969870/f59babe4d6d7dade7e55a78f0aacaef3a5d2d88c.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Greetings Heroes![/h2][p][/p][p]Today we are announcing that we will soon be leaving Early Access and releasing our 1.0 update. [/p][p][/p][p]Over the past months we've poured our hearts into making Evercore Heroes: Ascension the best it can be, working side by side with you, making the game better and more fun with each update! Unfortunately we’ve reached a point where we will no longer be able to further continue development.[/p][p][/p][p][b]This means that with the release of 1.0, we will be wrapping up active development for Evercore Heroes: Ascension. There won’t be any additional content updates, patches, or new features after this release.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]This decision has not been made lightly, but unfortunately we are not able to sustain further development of the game.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]What will happen next?[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]We’re committed to making sure [i]Evercore Heroes: Ascension[/i] will remain playable and enjoyable for all of you! [b]We are working on one more final patch[/b], releasing alongside 1.0, which will include new content, bug fixes and balance changes designed to leave the game in a good state for the future.[/p][p][/p][p]With this patch our priority is to make sure you can continue to jump into Lumerea, play your favorite hero, and continue to enjoy the game-. But, again, there will be no more new updates, content or patches after that.[/p][p][/p][p][b]You can expect the release of 1.0 to drop in a few weeks so keep an eye out for that![/b][/p][p][/p][p]From the bottom of our hearts - thank you for supporting us, playing and for being part of this journey with us![/p][p][/p][p][i]~Vela Games[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44969870/e474d036876e1fba0062b89b2b803fca9356181e.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Bonus Hero Weekend - Limited Time Event!
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44969870/3b239705c30c1c6ee2a9b5fd699ac6ee7bc0d5b3.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1]Greetings Heroes![/h1][p][/p][p]To celebrate the release of the biggest patch ever & the arrival of Ace Everstar we are launching a limited-time event that'll help you gather everything you need to unlock him![/p][p][/p][h2]Earn 50% more Evercore Fragments & up to 50% Valor Badges* when playing Adventure mode over the weekend![/h2][p][/p][p][b][i]* You earn 50% more Valor Badges in Solo Adventure, and 33% more in Co-Op Adventure[/i][/b][/p][p][/p][p]Along with the event we also got a small update for you with bug fixes and balance changes! There's never been a better time to dive into Lumerea, play with friends and bring Ace Everstar into your party![/p][p][/p][p]See you in-game![/p][p][/p][h2]PATCH NOTES[/h2][p][/p][p]We have a small patch based on some feedback and reports after launching Starstruck earlier this week.[/p][p][b]\[BALANCE][/b][/p][list][*][p][b]\[Frost Enemies][/b] We've increased the difficulty of enemies in Stormspire Summit. Some of these changes will impact both Adventure Mode and Strikes, while others are Adventure only. We wanted to make this section more noticeably distinct, especially in Adventure mode.[/p][list][*][p]Frost Artillery Golems now spawn a small swirling ice cloud when their missile bursts. It will not do damage but will apply Frost Stacks to players. You'll now want to deal with Artillery sooner than maybe you would have before.[/p][list][*][p]Their projectile AoE impact has been reduced in size, but raised slightly in damage in all modes.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Frost Tank Golems, Frost Yetis, Frost Wolves have had their health raised slightly in Adventure Mode only. We want these to be a little bit tougher as the last phase of an Adventure run.[/p][/*][*][p]Several enemies have had their attack timings increased slightly, to apply a little more pressure to respond.[/p][/*][*][p]Thrashclaw (both Kraggor and Kyross) now Roars a bit faster so he will spend less time Idle,[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]\[Frost Stacks][/b] will now clear faster, down from 2.5 seconds to 2 seconds. The movement speed debuff has been reduced from 50% to 40%. However, now only 5 stacks are required to trigger Ice Block, down from 6.[/p][/*][*][p][b]\[Health Orbs][/b] will now drop a little less frequently from smaller enemies and barrels, making it so there should be an overall reduction across the run of about 20-30% on average.[/p][/*][*][p][b]\[Core Power - Fighting Fit][/b] has had its Ability Power buff reduced from 5% per stack to 3%.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]\[BUG FIXES][/b][/p][list][*][p][b]\[Rewards][/b] Players should receive Valor Badges from their games even if they leave or disconnect before the end of the game.[/p][/*][*][p][b]\[Ace][/b] has had his Showdown ability improved, so it will be less likely to waste shots on barrels.[/p][/*][*][p][b]\[Ace][/b] has had his tooltips updated with the correct Luum cost for abilities.[/p][/*][*][p][b]\[Ranged Skill Shots][/b] have had a bug fixed that was causing them to not always rotate under certain network conditions.[/p][list][*][p]NOTE: we have a fix for this on Ranged Basic Attacks as well coming in the next patch.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]\[Displacement][/b] enemies will now displace properly when they are being killed.[/p][/*][*][p][b]\[UI][/b] The Island tracker in Adventure Mode should now update properly.[/p][/*][*][p][b]\[UI][/b] The Healer Golem's AOE indicator ring should now remove itself properly from players.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][i]~ Vela Games[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44969870/e474d036876e1fba0062b89b2b803fca9356181e.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Massive update is now LIVE!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube="0ZMeuCa-RNU;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h2]Greetings Heroes![/h2][p][/p][h3][b]Our first MAJOR UPDATE: Starstruck, is now LIVE![/b][/h3][p][/p][p]It's been just a month since launch and we’ve already rolled out Play as a Duo, 2+1 Matching, and over 100 bug fixes and improvements based on your feedback and we aren't stopping here![/p][p][/p][p]Now, [i]Starstruck[/i] takes the next leap with:[/p][list][*][p]A [b]brand new Adventure Game mode[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Ace Everstar:[/b] a new Hero to master[/p][/*][*][p]Across-the-board [b]combat and pacing improvements[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Below is an overview of what major changes are in the update, so you can jump in straight away! Want to read all the details? [b]Read the full patch notes with ALL the changes here:[/b][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2586780/view/498327923676161337"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44969870/e803627d755e50399f38834e78c4e0cb16f63ab3.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Venture down The Frozen Path![/h3][p]Adventure Mode is a high-stakes run through all of Kru - your ultimate test of survival, strategy, and endurance. In [i]The Frozen Path[/i], your team battles across five unique regions within Kru to reclaim the stolen Evercore Fragments. Longer runs, bigger risks, and wild, game-breaking builds await![/p][p][/p][p]Adventure mode is now the featured mode of the game, meaning that you can play in any way you want – join Solo Queue to find a party, try 2+1 Matchmaking, Play premade as Duo/Trio or of course play in Solo Mode.[/p][p][/p][p]Let’s see how far you can go![/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44969870/1a798501018455b4f09eb85983463b8153014935.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Blast off as Ace Everstar![/h3][p]Of course it wouldn’t be the Starstruck update without the star of the show himself, [i]Ace Everstar![/i][/p][p][/p][p]Ace is a gunslinger who shoots enemies with his dual blasters as well as his razor sharp wit. He’s a fluid ranged attacker who can dial in targets for maximum damage via his unique Nemesis system![/p][p][/p][p]How will you play him?[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44969870/aa557b0bf1f859c8903c502d3676145d279dea7f.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Combat & Pacing Improvements[/h3][p]We’re rolling out version 1 of our planned improvements to combat and game flow![/p][p][/p][p]For combat feel, we’ve tuned all hero animations to make [b]combat smoother[/b], [b]improved input[/b], and added [b]more impact[/b] to hits across the board.[/p][p][/p][p]We’ve also rebalanced pacing across the board - you’ll tear through enemies faster now, but there'll be more challenging moments, which will be tighter and more intense.[/p][p][/p][p]We’ve reworked Hero healing and enemy damage to smooth out spikes and open up new team comp options. With [b]Health Orb drops, you’re no longer locked into running a Support[/b] - take risks and get creative with the full hero roster![/p][p]
We’ve worked so hard to get this update out to you in such a short time, and we hope you’re as excited about as we are. Let us know what you think in the comments or on Discord![/p][p][/p][p]See you in Lumerea![/p][p][/p][p][i]~ The Vela Team[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44969870/e474d036876e1fba0062b89b2b803fca9356181e.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Starstruck update | Patchnotes
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44969870/0a3d48c864ccf2c68c63ae03e049f32c559340be.png"][/img][/p][h1]STARSTRUCK UPDATE | PATCH NOTES[/h1][p][/p][h2][b]NEW GAME MODE[/b][/h2][h3][b]Adventure Mode – The Frozen Path[/b][/h3][p]Adventure Mode is a high-stakes run through all of Kru - your ultimate test of survival, strategy, and endurance. In [i]The Frozen Path[/i], your team battles across five unique regions within Kru to reclaim the stolen Evercore Fragments. Longer runs, bigger risks, and wild, game-breaking builds await![/p][list][*][p]Adventure Mode is the main mode of the game and can be played in any way:[/p][list][*][p]Solo Matchmake to join a party of 3[/p][/*][*][p]Duo Matchmake for 2+1 parties[/p][/*][*][p]Play as Duo and Trio Premades[/p][/*][*][p]Solo Mode[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Adventure Mode is available to select on the new Co-Op Mode screen or in the Solo Mode screen.  There is no pre-requisite to access The Frozen Path.[/p][/*][*][p]As players progress through The Frozen Path, they will be rewarded instantly with Evercore Fragments at certain points during the adventure. We anticipate a large portion of players not making it to the end on every run, but you can still play this way as you’ll be rewarded for progress.[/p][list][*][p]Players will receive the same amount of Evercore Fragments in Co-Op or Solo Mode, but they will continue to receive a bonus for Valor Badges when playing Co-Op.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Players will encounter new variations of Enemies in each major region of Kru. Enemies and encounters have a unique balance setup in The Frozen Path that is separate from Co-Op or Solo Strike missions.[/p][/*][*][p]Players will see an Island Tracker system during Adventure Mode, so they can track their progress run to run.[/p][list][*][p][b]NOTE:[/b] [i]we are aware that on occasion, the Island Tracker may not display the correct landscape.[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]To promote The Frozen Path and keep matchmaking flowing smoothly, the existing standalone co-op maps of Shiverforge Mines and Stormspire Summit are now under a section called Co-Op Quick Strikes, and are available as premade Duos and Trios.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]NEW HERO[/b][/h2][h3][b]Ace Everstar[/b][/h3][p]Ace is a gunslinger who shoots enemies with his dual blasters as well as his razor sharp wit.  He’s a fluid ranged attacker who can dial in targets via his unique Nemesis system, for maximum damage.[/p][p]Ace’s Abilities:[/p][list][*][p][b]\[PASSIVE: NEMESIS][/b] Ace randomly marks an enemy as Nemesis, and will apply 25% increased damage against the market target with all attacks.[/p][/*][*][p][b]\[HEADSHOT][/b] Ace targets a direction and fires a piercing bullet that will do damage to all enemies in its range. If the bullet passes through his Nemesis, he will apply a guaranteed Critical Strike to that target.[/p][/*][*][p][b]\[VAULT][/b] Ace leaps over a target and fires two Basic Attacks at it, allowing for any Basic Attack “on hit” effects to activate.[/p][/*][*][p][b]\[MARKING SHOT][/b] Ace does damage to the first target he hits, and that target now becomes his Nemesis.[/p][/*][*][p][b]\[ULTIMATE: SHOWDOWN][/b] Ace fires a barrage of bullets into the air, and after a short delay the bullets all fly towards his Nemesis. If there is no Nemesis, it will target the closest enemy.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]NOTE:[/b] [i]Ace’s ultimate is meant to apply heavy damage to a single target, and thus is overall less powerful than Cynder, so it should be available more frequently during play.[/i][/p][p][/p][h2][b]QUALITY OF LIFE IMPROVEMENTS[/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]\[HERO MOVEMENT & ATTACKS][/b] We have reworked our animation system and Hero Animations to allow for more upper and lower body blending. The result should be smoother motion and better feel for all heroes.[/p][/*][*][p][b]\[DISPLACEMENT ABILITIES] [/b]Heroes will now displace enemies where appropriate on either Basic Attacks or Abilities. This should result in more impact when certain hits land, as well as making it easier for some heroes to skirmish.[/p][list][*][p][b]NOTE:[/b] [i]We anticipate some existing players will take a little time to get used to the new system, and we want to strike a good balance between precision and feel. We will continue to tune and refine this system in future updates.[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]\[SHARDS IN SOLO MODE] [/b]We’ve removed certain “co-op only” shards from Solo Mode in the Flame and Wild trees.[/p][list][*][p][b]NOTE:[/b] [i]We are aware that sometimes some players might see <REWARD NAME> instead of the correct name, and are continuing to track these issues down.[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]\[ENEMIES AFTER A DISCONNECT][/b] Enemies will now scale if someone drops from a Co-Op game on the next Island.[/p][/*][*][p][b]\[HERO PRICING] [/b]With the addition of Ace, we have lowered the price of all heroes going forward, to allow for a smoother ramp as players unlock new heroes. [/p][list][*][p]NEW HERO PRICING[/p][list][*][p][b]\[HERO 1][/b] 0 Evercore Fragments, 350 Valor Badges[/p][/*][*][p][b]\[HERO 2][/b] 3 Evercore Fragments, 750 Valor Badges[/p][/*][*][p][b]\[HERO 3][/b] 4 Evercore Fragments, 1000 Valor Badges[/p][/*][*][p][b]\[HERO 4][/b] 6 Evercore Fragments, 1500 Valor Badges[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]NOTE:[/b] [i]The system does continue to scale based on how many heroes you’ve unlocked, as we feel this gives you the best choice when deciding who to play.[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p] [/p][h2][b]BALANCE CHANGES[/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]\[ENEMIES & DAMAGE][/b] Enemies overall have had their Health and Damage reduced, while we have increased the number of enemies in encounters. This is intended to both provide a more distinct feel when fighting different enemies as well as make damage overall less spikey.[/p][list][*][p]We have also reduced the amount of Health scaling between Solo, Duo, and Trio modes for certain enemies, as we don’t want small enemies to be damage sponges. Heroes should continue to feel powerful against small enemies in all modes.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]\[HEALING OVERHAUL][/b] We wanted to increase the viability of hero comps in duos and trios that don’t include a Support Hero. While we want each role to have a specific purpose and unique feel, we want players to be able to make a conscious decision on comps and what they’re willing to bring (or forego) on a run.[/p][list][*][p][b]\[LOTUS & BEKO][/b] have both had their healing reduced overall, with Lotus being impacted more than Beko, as she’s been very strong on all fronts.[/p][/*][*][p][b]\[HEALING ORBS][/b] will now drop occasionally from barrels and enemies, and heal the party for 5 health. They will cause certain shards and other effects to activate as well.[/p][/*][*][p][b]\[RAMEN][/b] Your individual healing potion, or Ramen, now heals for a flat amount and has a cooldown. [/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]\[SOLO MODE BALANCE][/b] With the changes to Enemies, Damage, and Player Healing, Solo Mode should be much more smooth for all hero types (with some variation amongst specific heroes still of course).[/p][list][*][p][b]\[STORMSPIRE SUMMIT & SHIVERFORGE MINES SOLO][/b] are both now marked as “two diamonds” for difficulty.  We wanted to normalize the difficulty, but present players with different enemies and environmental gameplay without wildly scaling enemies.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]\[SHARDS] [/b]all shards now have 5 levels of Upgrades, up from 4. Several shards have had their power redistributed to be at the start and end levels. This allows players to try and maximize power in a variety of ways, such as going for variety, or trying to max out a few key shards.[/p][list][*][p]All shards have been altered in some form. Here is a list of some of the larger changes worth noting:[/p][/*][*][p][b]\[Basic Attack and Ability Power][/b] have had their initial values reduced, to allow for more levels and incentivize more active shards.[/p][/*][*][p][b]\[Parting Gift][/b] has had its initial damage values reduced, but has a much higher output at level 5 than previously.[/p][/*][*][p][b]\[Flex Armor][/b] has been rebalanced significantly.[/p][/*][*][p][b]\[Jagged Stoneskin] [/b]has been significantly increased in the damage that is returned.[/p][/*][*][p][b]\[Bomb Rush] [/b]will now displace enemies in the area of the bomb detonating.[/p][/*][*][p][b]\[Happy Gardner] [/b]has been changed to do a flat amount. Previously it was applying healing based on the caster’s Ability Power.[/p][/*][*][p]Players will receive a “MAX LEVEL” notification when they are presented with a shard that is already at its highest level. Please don’t select this, as it won’t do anything!![/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]\[NEW SHARD – Fists of Fury][/b] grants additional Attack Damage based on the amount of Luum you currently have. The more Luum, the more Attack Damage. This shard will occupy the “Basic Attack” slot.[/p][/*][*][p][b]\[FROST EFFECTS] [/b]Players can no longer DASH out of Frost Stacks.[b] [/b]As well,[b] [/b]the Ice Block effect has been increased in duration to 4 seconds.[/p][list][*][p][b]NOTE:[/b] [i]We felt this trivialized the challenge of Frost Enemies, and as we move damage down overall, we wanted other types of dangers. The stack count remains at 6.[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]\[WALLUMPS THE WICKED][/b] has been tuned again for both its Amber as Frost variants.[/p][/*][*][p][b]\[ENCOUNTERS - GAUNTLET] [/b]This encounter has been tweaked so that enemies now spawn in waves, allowing players to clear enemies quickly and make capture progress.[/p][/*][*][p][b]\[ENCOUNTERS – SURGE] [/b]The number of enemies in all versions of Surge have been increased, to account for the enemy rebalance, and to make these encounters more of a threat.[/p][/*][*][p][b]\[CYNDER] [/b]Cynder’s Ultimate Ability Burning Heart has been increased in cost, as it’s extremely powerful and encounter changing (as intended). We didn’t want to reduce his power, so we’ve made this available less often.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]BUG FIXES[/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]\[BASIC ATTACKS][/b] Fixed a bug that was sometimes causing “stutter stepping” on melee heroes, leading to a combo flow that was not smooth. Holding down or tapping the Basic Attack button should now be equally smooth.[/p][/*][*][p][b]\[SHARDS & SOULBOUND BLOOMS] [/b]We’ve implemented more fixes for rewards that should make them more reliable to grant.[/p][list][*][p][b]NOTE:[/b] [i]We are aware that sometimes some players might see <REWARD NAME> instead of the correct name, and are continuing to track these issues down.[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]\[SOULBOUND BLOOMS][/b] Players will no longer be presented with Soulbound Blooms that they already posses.[/p][list][*][p][b]NOTE:[/b] [i]we will be adding more levels of Soulbound Blooms in the future, as players technically could run out of choices and be presented with “Reward Name” blank choices.[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]\[KYROSS THRASHCLAW][/b] the pillars in this encounter will now more reliably block Kyross’s eye beam.[/p][/*][*][p][b]\[KRAGGOR THRASHCLAW][/b] we have temporarily reduced the damage and added other mitigating factors to help with the Prism Laser sometimes de-syncing.[/p][list][*][p][b]NOTE: [/b][i]We are continuing to investigate and fix the root issue of the de-sync.[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]\[HEROES][/b] we have fixed several abilities that could cancel themselves or get into a bad state.[/p][/*][*][p][b]\[UI] [/b]we have continued to fix various UI issues and loss of focus issues.[/p][/*][*][p][b]\[SOUND][/b] All Hero VO, Sound Effects, and UI Sounds should respect the Volume sliders in the options menu.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44969870/e474d036876e1fba0062b89b2b803fca9356181e.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Starstruck update spotlight
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44969870/3990fe38ea7e1bdf74d3b63abd52f56a7b194c9b.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1][b]Greetings Heroes![/b][/h1][p][/p][p]Welcome to a special spotlight for our first major update: [i][b]Starstruck! [/b][/i][/p][p][/p][p]This is our biggest update yet, and we’re excited to reveal what’s coming your way! Starstruck introduces a [i]brand-new game mode, improved combat and pacing across the board[/i], and of course - a totally new hero to master: Ace Everstar.[/p][p][/p][p]Mark your calendars as the[b] update will drop Tuesday, July 29th[/b]. That’s right… it’s almost here!![/p][p][/p][p]We’ll be sharing the patch notes soon, but for now here are some of the biggest features of the update![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44969870/e803627d755e50399f38834e78c4e0cb16f63ab3.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Venture down The Frozen Path![/b][/h2][p]We're excited to give you a look at the [b]brand-new mode[/b] included with this major update; [b]The Frozen Path![/b][/p][p][/p][p]This mode is an epic run through[b] ALL [/b]of Kru and the ultimate test of [i]survival, strategy[/i], and [i]endurance[/i] whether you're playing solo, as a duo, or as a full team of three![/p][p][/p][p]The Frozen Path has you start out in Ironcrag Hollow and journey through five distinct parts of Kru, on a journey to recover the stolen Evercore Fragments.[/p][p][/p][p]Let’s dive in![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44969870/49ec9e1880fa7dc19b189e08830bf5a9a47e6db8.gif"][/img][/p][p][i]Travel through ALL of Kru in ONE epic run![/i][/p][p][/p][h2][b]The Ultimate Gauntlet[/b][/h2][p]The Frozen Path is the ultimate gauntlet - the way we imagined Ascension to be played with friends.[b] Longer runs, higher stakes, and way more room to break the game wide open[/b] with the most absurd builds you can dream up![/p][p][/p][p]The deeper... Uh, higher you venture, the more the difficulty ramps up! Not just through boosting enemy stats but by [b]introducing unique enemy variants[/b] with tweaked abilities in each region you visit![/p][p][/p][p]But it’s not just about surviving, [b]we’re changing how rewards work too[/b]! The Frozen Path is brutal by design, and we don’t expect you to finish it every time you play. So instead of locking rewards behind completion,[b] you’ll earn Evercore Fragments based on how far you make it[/b]. Progress is progress, and every step counts![/p][p][/p][p]Higher risk, bigger rewards. Every island you clear will hit harder - and feel better![/p][p][/p][p]Let’s see how far you can go![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Blast off as Ace Everstar![/b][/h3][p]Of course it wouldn’t be the Starstruck update without the [b]star of the show himself, [i]Ace Everstar![/i][/b] We’ve already previewed him [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2586780/view/511837723210809899"]HERE[/url] but he’ll be arriving in this update as well![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2586780/view/511837723210809899"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Ace will follow our existing Hero Pricing model, meaning his cost depends on how many heroes you’ve already unlocked - using [b]in-game currency only[/b] (Evercore Fragments and Valor Badges).[/p][p][/p][p]For those of you who already own all current heroes, Ace will cost the same as your sixth unlock. No price hikes, [i]no surprises[/i] - just make sure you’re stocked up when he drops on Tuesday![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44969870/1a798501018455b4f09eb85983463b8153014935.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Combat & Pacing Improvements![/b][/h2][p]Based on your feedback, we’ve overhauled combat to make it[i] smoother, snappier[/i], and[i] way more satisfying![/i] [b]We’ve upgraded animations, VFX, and hit reactions[/b] to make every swing, shot, and slam feel more impactful than before![/p][p][/p][p]We’ve also rebalanced pacing across the board - you’ll tear through enemies faster now, but don’t get too comfortable. The challenge has shifted to checkpoints, which will be tighter and more intense.[/p][p][/p][p]Healing has also been reworked. [b]We’ve added more ways for you to sustain yourself during runs[/b], giving you new tools to survive without leaning entirely on a Support. While Support heroes will always have a place ([i]and still shine in tough fights[/i]), daring duos or trios can now pull off viable runs without one. This opens up more comp variety and will make it easier to experiment. And for you that prefer to play solo? The experience should feel more fair - and more rewarding - than ever![/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44969870/aa557b0bf1f859c8903c502d3676145d279dea7f.gif"][/img]  [/p][p][/p][h2][b]What are you most excited for?[/b][/h2][p]Starstruck is our biggest update yet and we are beyond excited to hear from you on what you are looking forward to the most! [/p][p][/p][p][b]Drop your thoughts in the comments or hit us up on Discord as we'd love to hear from you![/b][/p][p][/p][p]See you next Tuesday![/p][p][/p][p][i]~ Vela Team[/i][/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44969870/e474d036876e1fba0062b89b2b803fca9356181e.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: First look at a NEW HERO!
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44969870/464d25bc8fe4bc9a6de8d82c50b436e704339926.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Straight from the stars - meet Ace Everstar![/b][/h2][p]Some say he came from the stars, others claim he's always been around offering the best goods in the galaxy! One thing is for sure, Ace Everstar never misses his mark and [b]always gets paid![/b][/p][p][/p][p]With dual energy blasters and an irresistible charm, Ace isn’t in it for the glory of saving the world. He’s here for the thrill of the hunt and a nice paycheck at the end of it! Whether he’s chasing bounties or dodging the consequences of last night’s decisions, Ace moves fast, hits hard, and disappears with a big fat tip![/p][p][/p][h3][b]New to the roster![/b][/h3][p]We’re excited to give you a [b]first look[/b] at our next playable hero - [b]Ace Everstar[/b]. You might know him as the shopkeeper but there’s way more to him than meets the eye! He’s flashy, he’s deadly, and he’s not above bending the rules if it gets the job done.[/p][p][/p][p]In this sneak peek we'll dive into his playstyle and what you can expect from him joining the crew to save the Evercore.. well, all for a price of course![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44969870/1b86acb6b5f6f6161011ede655ace5b49ca204e5.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Playstyle[/b][/h3][p]Ace Everstar is a [b]high-mobility ranged damage dealer[/b] - perfect for players who like to stay on the move, pick off key targets, and stay one step ahead of danger.[/p][p][/p][p]Ace focuses on eliminating targets he deems his ‘nemesis’ - every hero needs one after all - and any enemy marked this way will receive increased damage from his basic attacks and abilities. Being the bounty hunter he is, Ace has multiple ways to make sure his targets won’t escape and can put on a chase by jumping over enemies and stopping them in their tracks before delivering the final shot![/p][p][/p][p]What separates a good Ace player from a great one is the ability to mark the right enemies, staying on the move while blasting your nemesis and staying out of danger doing it. His burst damage isn’t as high as Shade nor are his AOE capabilities anywhere near that of Cynder, but you’ll have a lot more consistent damage to play with as well as mobility options to utilize to change the flow of combat in your favor![/p][p][/p][p]As a ranged gunslinger with access to a guaranteed crit ability you’ll do well focusing on (crit) damage and shards that offer on-hit effects. You can’t go wrong with any shard that either uses or compliments your mobility as well! It might be wise stocking up on at least one defensive shard to avoid that unfortunate situation where you do get caught out of position - you'll thank me later![/p][p][/p][p]If chasing down your nemesis with two - pew pew - dual blasters sounds like fun, then he’s the [i]‘Ace’[/i] up your sleeve![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Let us know what you think![/b][/h3][p]While working on Ace Everstar we asked ourselves - [b]what do you think?[/b] Does Ace fit your playstyle? Do you already have a build in mind? Let us know![/p][p][/p][p]Next week we’ll keep exploring what’s coming next in the major update by taking you on an adventure to to our new game mode, [i]The Frozen Path[/i]...[/p][p][/p][p][i]~ Vela Team[/i][/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44969870/e474d036876e1fba0062b89b2b803fca9356181e.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: DUO matchmaking is LIVE!!!
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44969870/3a2c485cd10a914042ebfd64a97fefb3cb8265be.png"][/img][/p][h2]Greetings heroes![/h2][p][/p][p]With the release of this patch we complete our most requested feature (duo mode), add a highly requested quality-of-life change as well as a limited-time bonus event we think you’ll appreciate![/p][p][/p][p][b]We've halved the in-game cost to unlock Core Powers from now till the end of the weekend![/b] It's the perfect time to jump in, play and unlock some more of the more expensive powers![/p][p][/p][h3]Patch summary[/h3][list][*][p][b]2+1 matchmaking is now live![/b] You can now queue up together with your friend and find a third player via matchmaking![/p][/*][*][p]You can now [b]hold down your basic attack key to keep attacking[/b]; No more button mashing! [/p][/*][*][p]We've added [b]Tons more bug fixes![/b][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]What's next?[/h3][p]With the [b]full launch of Duo Mode now live[/b], we're happy to share that development is moving steadily - and we're currently ahead of schedule on our roadmap!
[/p][p]We're already gearing up for our next major update, which will introduce a variety of new features, including an entirely [b]new[/b] [b]game mode[/b] and the debut of our first new hero: [b]Ace Everstar[/b].
[/p][p]As always, thank you for your continued support and valuable feedback![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44969870/ab9ffd0b7c7bae57d112936bf292f2e294d4ea97.png"][/img][/p][h1]FULL PATCH NOTES[/h1][p][/p][h3][b]NEW FEATURE[/b][/h3][p][b]2+1 Matchmaking – Full Duo Support is Now Live![/b][/p][list][*][p]Simply go to the Match Start screen by visiting the Portal in Castle Everae, add one friend to your match screen, and you will be presented with “Play as a Duo” or “Matchmake”.[/p][/*][*][p]For Duos that join the Matchmaking Queue, they will be matched with the first Solo Queue player available, regardless of region.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]QOL Improvements[/b][/h3][p][b]Updated Basic Attacks[/b]. Another point of feedback we wanted to address was improving the Basic Attack feel for all heroes.[/p][list][*][p]We’ve added support to “hold” the attack button now for Basic Attack as well as allowing more movement. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]We’ve also tuned some Heroes’ attack timing and VFX.  In some cases, we’ve compensated for changed attack timing with updated damage values. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]This is a medium level change, and we’ll be continuing to look at more combat improvements in the future![/p][/*][/list][p][b]Core Keys and Core Gems are now granted immediately [/b]upon completion of the Encounter.[/p][list][*][p]Originally, we had designed Gems and Keys to be granted at the end of the game (to help cut down on Leavers in Co-Op), but wanted to be more forgiving and ensure you keep all the Gems and Keys you earn![/p][/*][/list][p][b]The Abandon Run option is now available in Co-Op runs[/b]. Originally, we had designed this to help prevent Leaving during Co-Op runs, but we’ve enabled this to make game restarts easier on everyone.[/p][p][b]Enemies will now Scale automatically on the next Island after a Disconnect[/b]. This will ensure that should you lose a player on your run, the balance of the game will adjust accordingly.[/p][list][*][p][b]NOTE[/b]:  If a player is in Co-Op and eventually drops down to one solo player, they will still encounter Co-Op specific objectives.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Solo Mode[/b] now has its own screen on the Mode Selection button, indicated at the top of the screen.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]\[SHARDS & SOULBOUND BLOOMS] [/b]We’ve done a large amount of work to ensure that rewards earned at the end of encounters are granted correctly, as well as improving the performance of the menus themselves under high latency.  This should fix several of the issues players were seeing before.[/p][list][*][p][b]NOTE:[/b] We are aware that sometimes some players might see <REWARD NAME> instead of the correct name, and are continuing to track these issues down.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]\[ENCOUNTERS][/b] Fixed a bug where occasionally a small set of Surge encounters would not spawn enemies correctly in Shiverforge Mines.[/p][/*][*][p][b]\[ENCOUNTERS][/b] Fixed a few various issues related to the wrong reward category being granted, and a few encounters that had too many enemies.[/p][/*][*][p][b]\[ENEMIES][/b] Improved behaviour of Enemies so that they should spawn more reliably and stop moving less frequently.[/p][/*][*][p][b]\[SOUND][/b] Hero Attack and Take Damage VO should now respect the VO Volume Slider as expected.[/p][/*][*][p][b]\[SOUND][/b] Fixed a bug that was causing unintended music to play on repeat games.[/p][/*][*][p][b]\[UI][/b] Continued to fix several “loss of focus” issues.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]Balance[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]\[BASIC ATTACKS] [/b]all heroes have had their animations tuned slightly, with some very minor and some a little more significant.  [b]Shade and Cynder[/b] have had base damage turned up to compensate.[/p][/*][*][p][b]\[WALLUMPS][/b] has had his Co-Op Overshield values in each phase increased, making the fight closer to how it was originally intended.[/p][/*][*][p][b]\[CO-OP ENEMIES[/b]] several more difficult enemies in Duos and Trios have had their Hitpoints reduced slightly.[/p][list][*][p][b]NOTE: [/b]We’ll be doing a large re-balance in our Starstruck Update to improve game pacing in a more comprehensive way, but for now we’re continuing to touch down enemies that have a longer fight time.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]\[SHADE] [/b]increased the Critical Strike Chance granted by Blink from 8% to 15%.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44969870/e474d036876e1fba0062b89b2b803fca9356181e.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: 100 Reviews - "Mostly Negative"? Here's what happened!

[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44969870/c495e2c9f313337170118873e4b4f69db921dc56.png"][/img][/p][p]If you’re discovering this game and thinking:[/p][list][*][p]“That’s a pretty rough review score…”[/p][/*][*][p] “What happened here?”  [/p][/*][*][p]“Wasn’t Evercore Heroes a different kind of game?”[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]You’re not wrong to be confused. We want to be upfront and clear with you - whether you’re new, returning, or somewhere in between.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]🎮 What [i]is[/i] this game?[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][b]Evercore Heroes: Ascension[/b] - or just [i]Ascension[/i], as we’ll be calling it more going forward - is a brand-new [b]co-op roguelite[/b], built for [b]1 - 3 players[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]Pick from one of 6 unique heroes (with more coming) and go on challenging PvE runs. Face co-op specific encounters, collect rewards, and build powerful loadouts. Think action, challenge, repeatable runs, and learning-as-you-go.[/p][p][/p][p]There’s no PvP. No team competition. Just you and 1 or 2 friends vs. the world of Lumerea.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]🧭 Confusion & Frustration - Legacy Expectations[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]We previously released a different game: [b]Evercore Heroes[/b] - a competitive, team-based PvEvP MOBA experience for 16 players at a time. That game was big and ambitious, but did not find the success it needed to be sustainable, so it was shut down in 2023.[/p][p][/p][p]When we started building [i]Ascension[/i], we kept the world, the characters, and the name - because we still believed in what we had built creatively. We thought we communicated a clear departure from the first game, but it didn’t land, and led to endless confusion.[/p][p][/p][p]We launched [i]Ascension [/i]into expectations that were never going to be met - and for a lot of players who were around for the first game, that was jarring and disappointing, which is never what you want as a Developer.[/p][p][/p][p]We needed a cleaner break between the first two games, and we’ll be doing that going forward.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]👥 Duo Mode – A Big Miss on Day One[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]When we did launch [i]Ascension [/i]last week, our initial feedback immediately highlighted a pretty big gap: [b]no Duo Mode![/b][/p][p][/p][p]Duo Mode was a key part of the “play solo or with friends” experience we envisioned. Not having it at launch was an oversight - and we know it held players back from fully diving in. We really do regret missing this on Day 1 and have definitely learned another valuable lesson.[/p][p][/p][p]While it was already on our roadmap to deliver soon, we pushed it to the top of the priority list for a quick rollout the morning after launch. Good news: Duo Mode is live now, two days after launch, so you can team up with a friend for full runs.

 [u][url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2586780/view/498325386812195346?"]Read more here![/url][/u][url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2586780/view/498325386812195346?"]  [/url][/p][p][/p][h3][b]🚧 What’s happened since launch?[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Even with a rough start, we’ve already been making fast updates:[/p][list][*][p]✅ [b]Duo Mode[/b] is live - play full runs with a friend[/p][/*][*][p]✅ [b]Bug fixes and movement improvements [/b]already rolled out[/p][/*][*][p]✅ [b]Listening hard[/b] - feedback is shaping what comes next[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We’re also working on:[/p][list][*][p]More bug fixes and QoL improvements to come in [b]Patch 2, later this week[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]And after that: more content and build variety, as well as a new mode[/p][/*][/list][p]We know the game still needs more work, and we are dedicated to keep improving the experience! We hope to earn your trust with frequent communication and patches.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]🙌 If you're a potential new player - here's what we’d say:[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][i]Ascension [/i]is a game we believe in - a co-op PvE roguelite built for unique hero-driven action, by a small, passionate team.[/p][p][/p][p][b]If you're even a little curious[/b], give it a shot![/p][p][b]And if you're enjoying it?[/b] A positive review right now helps more than you know.[/p][p][/p][p]We know first impressions matter, and we’re doing everything we can to earn a second one.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for reading - and if you stick around, thanks even more.[/p][p][/p][p][i]~ The Evercore Team[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44969870/e474d036876e1fba0062b89b2b803fca9356181e.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Play as Duo is here!
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44969870/dfac025ca17f3af40e59075349b23e24d0ced4f6.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Greetings heroes![/h2][p][/p][p][b]Play as Duo[/b] [b]is HERE![/b][/p][p]Team up with your best friend, sibling, or partner, and experience the world of Lumerea together. This beta feature will let you and one other player play as a two-person team - no third player required! Simply invite a friend to your party, and start the game from the Match Start Portal! You can find more details in the Patch Notes below.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Why didn't we include this with Early Access release?[/b][/p][p]Our original plan was to introduce both Play as a Duo and Duo (2+1) matchmaking together, but your feedback told us loud and clear that you wanted a way to play as a duo right away. So we've released this version first, while we continue working on the 2+1 matchmaking system for a future patch.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Is full duo (2+ 1) matchmaking coming later?[/b][/p][p]Yes! We're actively developing full duo matchmaking, allowing pairs of players to matchmake and join with a random third player seamlessly. It's a challenging feature to implement reliably, but we're committed to getting it right. Stay tuned as we'll keep you updated on our progress![/p][p][/p][p]Alongside Play as a Duo beta, we've also included bug fixes, balance adjustments, and quality-of-life improvements just in time for the weekend![/p][p][/p][p]We can't wait to see how you and your duo partner take on Lumerea, let us know what you think![/p][p][/p][h2]Patch notes[/h2][p][/p][p][b]Play as a Duo (BETA)[/b][/p][list][*][p]Players can now start a match with just two players in our Play as Duo BETA.[/p][/*][*][p]Simply go to the Match Start screen by visiting the portal in Castle Everae, add one friend to your match screen, and start the game![/p][/*][*][p]Players will still have the option to start a game as a Trio in the same way as before.[/p][/*][*][p]Duos will work like Trios, in that a random map will be selected, set at the "Co-Op difficulty" level, meaning both maps should provide similar levels of challenge.[/p][/*][*][p]The Party Leader's REGION setting will be used when starting the match.[/p][/*][*][p]KNOWN ISSUES:[/p][list][*][p]When you are in the Matchmaking Queue, and get invited to a party, you might still see the "Searching for Match" UI element, but you are NOT in the Queue.[/p][/*][*][p]When in Hero Select with a Duo, you will still see a 3rd, empty slot with the name "PlayerName" above it.[/p][/*][*][p]If you are in a duo party, and invite a third person who accepts right when the party leader starts the game, some players may get stuck on the Match Found screen.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b]QOL Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p]All movement abilities should be much smoother now when playing online and rubber-band less, greatly improving the feel of these abilities in co-op.[/p][/*][*][p]If a player drops during a co-op game for any reason, on the next island, monsters will scale down to the appropriate difficulty settings.[/p][/*][*][p]The Cosmetics and Cooking Station previews have been removed, and are planned to be reintroduced in the future when functional.[/p][/*][*][p]Frenzy buff clouds should have a very short slow down after you exit the cloud.[/p][/*][*][p]We have added a short note on the Hero Unlock screen that mentions Hero Pricing will increase after each purchase [i](we made no actual changes - it's just to clarify)[/i]
[b]NOTE:[/b] we implemented this system to make it so getting your first hero was fairly quick and easy, but then further unlocks require more mastery from players.[/p][/*][*][p]The default Volume level for Music has been increased on a fresh install so that it's more audible.[/p][/*][*][p]Some Hero VO ability sounds during attacks have had their levels adjusted.[/p][/*][*][p]Hero VO ability and damage sounds should now respect 3D space.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]\[Encounters][/b] Fixed a bug where occasionally a Battlehorn encounter would not spawn enemies correctly on Stormspire Summit.[/p][/*][*][p][b]\[Core Powers][/b] Fixed a bug where Energise Level 2 reverted to Level 1 on taking Damage. It should now revert correctly to Level 2.[/p][/*][*][p][b]\[Enemies][/b] Fixed a few issues with Kraggor Thrashclaw's laser not working as intended.[/p][/*][*][p][b]\[UI][/b] Fixed a few issues with the cursor jumping to different parts of the screen.[/p][/*][*][p][b]\[UI][/b] Fixed a bug where the Shard Reward screen can lose one option if a player disconnects.[/p][/*][*][p][b]\[UI][/b] Fixed a bug where a Beko Tip message would stay on the screen in the HUB occassionally.[/p][/*][*][p][b]\[UI][/b] Fixed a bug where the shop vendor screen would sometimes not open and cause the game to hang.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Balance[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]PLAY AS A DUO:[/b] we've put in an initial balancing pass for Play as a Duo. Duos will face co-op specific objectives, and larger numbers of enemies than in Solo play. To compensate for a greater number of monsters, the enemy HP values are relatively lower. Basically, more enemies, but squishier for Play as a Duo.[/p][/*][*][p][b]IRONCRAG HOLLOW:[/b] this run has been rebalanced to provide a smoother difficulty ramp up for this EASY Solo run.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Kraggor Thrashclaw's eye beam[/b] into the centre Crystal cannot be blocked by Fyn's shield. We felt like this was diminishing the fight too much. The beams emitting from the Crystal can still be blocked.[/p][/*][*][p]Fyn and Cynder Ultimate costs have been raised by about 30% as they're extremely powerful and were occurring more than intended for their relative power levels.[/p][/*][*][p]Fyn's Overshield gain from Get Behind me reduced from 5 per projectile blocked to 3.[/p][/*][*][p]Fyn's Shield Toss now stuns enemies it hits for 1 second, down from 2.
This change is intended to still provide interrupt utility for Fyn, but allow enemies to respond quicker when used as an opening move on a camp.[/p][/*][*][p]The large Roller enemies have had their health reduced slightly.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Let us know what you think and consider leaving a review if you like what you play!
[/p][p][i]See you in-game![/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44969870/e474d036876e1fba0062b89b2b803fca9356181e.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Demo Patch 3 Now Live | Getting ready for Steam Next Fest!
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44969870/3a408277b2136d7c0e1800533203b96000d18236.png"][/img][/p][h2]Greetings heroes![/h2][p][/p][p][b]Thank you all for continuing to play and give us feedback on Ascension![/b][/p][p][/p][p]This is now our 3rd patch in 3 weeks of the demo going live, and we're really committed to listening to you and addressing as many issues as possible. As we continue onto Early Access release, you can expect the same level of commitment![/p][p]The main focus of this patch continues to be tuning the balance of the game, with several changes to enemies throughout the experience, while also scaling down some of the crazy Critical Strike builds possible.[/p][p]Also, we've got a camera change that will hopefully improve play for everyone, but especially those using Ultrawide resolutions ([i]we got you![/i]).[/p][p]Thank you again![/p][p][/p][h2]🗝️Early Access game key giveaway[/h2][p]To celebrate Early Access and being part of Next Fest - we are [b]giving away 20 Evercore Heroes: Ascension Early Access game keys![/b] Complete tasks like playing the demo for an hour to improve your chance of winning - we'll draw the winners on the 16th of June when Next Fest ends! [/p][p][b]You can participate in the giveaway by going [url="https://gleam.io/Nx87X/steam-next-fest-competition-for-a-free-early-access-game-key"]HERE![/url][/b] [img src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1091634470257434624.webp?size=40"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]🎥IMPROVED CAMERA + ULTRAWIDE SUPPORT[/h2][p]We have made a change to the Camera in the game and the way it calculates Field of View. This should result in slightly improved visibility for all players and support Ultrawide resolutions properly.[/p][p][/p][h2]🦸HEROES[/h2][p]• [b]New Soulbound Blooms:[/b] that increase your Hero's ultimate charge rate are in for all Heroes (for real this time...)  [/p][p]• [b]Shade:[/b] Critical Strike chance after a Blink increased from 5% to 8% to make it slightly more attractive to use.  [/p][p](Note that this ability does also make her Untargetable, as a friendly reminder to those aspiring Shade players!)[/p][p][/p][h2]💎SHARDS[/h2][p]• [b]Jagged Stoneskin:[/b] Has been woefully underpowered, and now grants 300%+ return of damage to enemies.  [/p][p]• [b]Penscythe's Mark:[/b] Damage modifier reduced to 1, 2, 3, 4 per stack, per level.  [/p][p]• [b]Sorcerer's Gloves:[/b] Now activates every 4 ability uses, with crit chance now at 10, 13, 16, 19%. [/p][p]• [b]Base Critical Strike Shard:[/b] Now grants 5, 7, 9, or 11% crit chance.  [/p][p](Note – these critical strike shards can still grant a large amount of power when on a maxed out crit build, it was just too easy to scale rapidly before.) [/p][p]• [b]Parting Gift:[/b] Tooltip error corrected — it never could Critically Strike. This fix should make [i]Lucky Death Boom[/i] more appealing for crit explosion fans.  [/p][p]• [b]Beefy:[/b] Temporarily removed while we fix a bug that could block Double Dash.[/p][p][/p][h2]👹ENEMIES[/h2][p]• [b]Large Ice Wolf:[/b] Howl damage reduced significantly in Solo and Co-Op. Fracture magnitude and duration increased.  [/p][p]• [b]Small Golem Slasher:[/b] Spin damage reduced.  [/p][p]• [b]Large Golem Slasher:[/b] Damage slightly reduced overall, now immune to hit pause.  [/p][p]• [b]Golem Tank:[/b] AOE damage and fracture slightly reduced, now also immune to hit pause.  [/p][p](NOTE: These hit pause changes fit thematically with larger enemies, and also make them slightly more dangerous for ranged Heroes.)  [/p][p][b]• Golem Shooter:[/b] Slight damage reduction in co-op.  [/p][p]• [b]Artillery Golem:[/b] Bombs now persist after death, but deal slightly less damage.  [/p][p]• [b]Yeti:[/b] Movement speed increased slightly.  [/p][p]• [b]Thrashclaw:[/b] Damage reduced on several abilities. notes.title: Reworked roguelike Evercore Heroes Ascension finally gets launch date
notes.notes:
I remember previewing Evercore Heroes: Ascension two years ago. Its vibrant characters and intense, competitive action certainly scratched the League of Legends itch, with the PvE combat making it feel more akin to a playable Race to World First tournament than a traditional MOBA. But a lot has changed: in 2024 Vela Games announced that the game was undergoing a slight transformation, booting the competitive PvP element to focus entirely on PvE and add in roguelike-inspired elements. Since then, the team's been hard at work bringing its new vision to life and, if you've been following Evercore as closely as I have, you'll be excited to know that it's finally got a launch date - and it's just around the corner.

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44969870/c597bbe3f38b8fb2efaaf6f832e430c8ce72cf27.png[/img]

[h2]Greetings heroes![/h2]

Thanks for playing the Evercore Heroes: Ascension demo! 

We’ve seen a lot of you out there playing, and we’re [b]committed to making frequent improvements based on your feedback[/b]. This patch includes bug fixes, balance tweaks, and some quality-of-life improvements to make your experience smoother - especially in the early stages of your runs!

Enjoy & let us know what you think and want to see next!

[h3]Gameplay & Balance[/h3]
• [b]Made “Easy” enemies easier:[/b] Reduced their damage and attack speed to improve early run pacing and to give you a little more space to learn new heroes. 
• [b]Reduced base Skill Power and Attack Damage shards.[/b] This is in part to make other shards more powerful as they're situational. Part of ongoing tuning for time-to-kill and encounter difficulty.  
• [b]Thrashclaw HP slightly reduced[/b] in both solo and co-op to balance difficulty.  
• [b]Wallumps and large Kru enemies rebalance:[/b] Wallumps the Wicked, Yetis, and large Armoured Rollers are now immune to hitstun/displacement but have reduced HP in solo play.  Additionally, Golem Tanks are immune to hitstun.
• [b]Parting Gift now ignores barrels:[/b] Prevents accidental griefing due to a lack of Luum.
• [b]New Soulbound Ultimate Blooms:[/b] You now have a chance to get a Soulbound Bloom that grants a 25% increase of charging speed for their Ultimate abilities.

[h3]Hero Updates[/h3]
• [b]Beko’s Lantern Pop Skill now triggers Skill Damage shards.[/b] This means that while the ability still doesn't do base damage, the skill will now interact with Skill Damage shards. This should give Beko more build varieties to help the little guy out, especially in Solo runs.
• [b]Beko’s Lantern Pop Detonation [/b] is now centered on the lantern target at activation time.  
• [b]Beko’s basic attack sequence sped up by ~10%.[/b] Helps Beko better dodge enemy attacks.
• [b]Lotus AOE Bright Petals now slightly heals both herself as allies:[/b] Adds more clarity and utility to the ability.
• [b]Ranged basic attacks on Cynder and Beko deprioritize barrels more effectively:[/b] This should help improve targeting!
• [b]Ultimates are now more reliable:[/b] They no longer cancel as easily and won’t consume a charge if interrupted prematurely.

[h3]UI & UX Improvements[/h3]
• [b]CloudEE has new messages:[/b] Talk to them (hint, it's the little floating robot) in the Hub or in-game to learn more!
• [b]We added some additional messaging[/b] to explain how to change your Hero on the Solo Map selection so it's not just Lotus in the spotlight!
• [b]Victory and defeat screens updated:[/b] New icons and cleaner formatting.
 
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
• [b]Resurrection fixes:[/b] You should no longer be invincible after resurrecting in rare occasions. There is still an issue where some heroes might slide slightly during which we'll work on in a future patch.
• [b]Soulbound Bloom fixes:[/b] Several Soulbound Blooms were not granting the proper power which you should now see go up!
• [b]Fixed several crash bugs[/b] — thanks to everyone who submitted reports!!!  
• [b]Fixed issues with card flipping causing input issues[/b] and friends list occasionally not closing with gamepad.
• [b]Fixed Wallumps rock throw[/b] ending prematurely in some cases. Better hide!
• [b]Fixed Shard Collection UI bugs:[/b] Categories should no longer disappear after selection.

• [b]Fixed tooltip mismatches:[/b] Shade Slash cost now displaying correctly.
• [b]Fixed “More to Share” [/b] shard not applying properly.
• [b]Fixed “Protein Powder” shard not applying Attack Damage buff [/b] properly in some cases when interacting with the Golden Strike shard. 
• [b]Fixed “Mediport Module” [/b] not always applying the proper amount of healing. 
• [b]Fixed “Chemical Reaction” [/b] not always being active for the correct duration. 
• [b]Fixed “Luum Refund” [/b] not displaying the correct amounts of Luum granted. 
• [b]Fixed “Consolation Prize” [/b] not always interacting with Beko properly. 
• [b]Fixed “Plague Strike” [/b]typo in the tooltip.

[h2]Greetings heroes![/h2]

We are two weeks in and have so far revealed both our new support as tank hero! It’s high time we have a look at the new damage dealing hero as well!

[i]Step out of the shadows and into the light with...[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44969870/01a7f2e28de9932bd50b8abbd0b72b939fa740c6.gif[/img]

[h2]Shade: the Shadow Blade[/h2]

Hiding in the shadows, no target who has ever seen Shade has been able to tell the tale. Coming from the dark cyberpunk city of Noktra, she’s a master assassin that does anything to get the job done, even if that means working together as a team!

Shade does not want to be seen and is your assassin archetype hero. She excels at locating high priority targets and dealing high single target damage with multiple ways to get both out-as into danger.

If high damage numbers and flashy skill expression is what you are looking for then Shade is made for [b]YOU![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44969870/df8dffb187ce907586230c8d098d26104d60e640.gif[/img]

[h2]DPS playstyle[/h2]

Shade is all about staying safe, striking when the moment is right and getting out when things get too hot under her feet. Being a squishy character a few hits can prove fatal if dispositioned after all. Luckily Shade has a lot of tools to close the gap and get out of danger.

Where Cynder has a lot of AOE abilities and range to do his damage safely from afar, Shade will have to put herself at risk and jump in and out to be effective. To help you on your mission she has not one dash, but [b]THREE[/b] of them! Outside of your normal dash, you’ll have a blink ability that doesn’t just make you dash but also drops all aggro while doing so and you have a jump that damages all enemies you dash through for extra damage. Use them wisely as every misstep can be [i]deadly…[/i]

What makes a good Shade player is figuring out when it’s safe to jump in and when it’s better to wait or swap targets. Good targets to go for are those that are weak or critical like shooting enemies or bigger healers that keep enemies alive. There is no shame in playing the objective and assassinating vulnerable enemies in the backline rather than going for the big yeti in the spotlight!

As a melee damage dealer, your main focus will be on direct damage shards to boost her damage even further rather than utility. Being a more melee squishy character with high damage it can also be wise to pick up one or two defensive options to survive the occasional big hits.

Having to pick off targets and dashing in and out grants Shade a unique playstyle that’s very different from any other damage dealing hero!

Last week we had a look at our new support hero Beko, the spirit of rejuvenation as well as fan favorite!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44969870/ccd63c499cad8b11f9a7017fc4dd6396df7347fc.gif[/img]

[h2]Riiva: the berserker tank[/h2]

Fearless, full of fury & driven by rage, Riiva is a formidable warrior that makes you ROAR! Throwing herself into danger to protect her allies, you definitely do NOT want to be on her bad side!

Riiva is not your traditional tank, wielding twin axes and jumping into the fray - she is the embodiment of offense being the best defense! Where she lacks a level of tankiness and the ability to stun enemies she makes up for it by being able to parry crucial hits and dealing more damage in prolonged fights.

If you like to charge your enemies head-on, deal damage by staying in the fray and go completely wild then Riiva is your hero of choice!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44969870/90df1e033fd0bb1f5716c7220c2ef8822493159c.gif[/img]

[h2]Tanking style[/h2]

Riiva is all about living on the edge, taking risks and going wild to keep your allies safe! She has quite a few tools to do this like throwing her axe to not only slow and taunt enemies further away but also granting her the ability to jump to it. You can use this to either close the gap, switch enemy targets OR secure an escape path when things get too hot!

What sets apart a good Riiva player from a great one is the ability to parry abilities pitch perfect! Learn the abilities of your enemies and you will be capable of not just avoiding damage mid-fight, but also be able to avoid stunning effects which would leave most heroes powerless!

Where a more traditional tanking hero like Fyn prefers to build more defensive shards to be this unstoppable body, Riiva has more flexible options as a tank/damage dealing hybrid. Offensive shards like on-hit effects for example are pretty powerful on Riiva as her attack speed increases while she fights meaning you’ll get quite a lot of hits in.

Stay on the move, parry enemy abilities and go ham- Riiva is a berserker type tank that’s tougher to learn but will grant more skill expression and power in the right hands!

We are excited to announce that we are adding 3 new heroes to the roster! This means that for the next demo you’ll have access to 2 support, 2 tank and 2 DPS characters.

[h2]Beko: The Spirit Healer[/h2]

Slightly mysterious with their mask but also utterly adorable, it is said that Beko is secretly a powerful ancient spirit of rejuvenation! Coming from an actual swimming giga-turtle island we call Moxy, Beko is a powerful healer using a mystical lantern to keep their allies safe!

Beko is your more traditional healer, focusing on keeping allies and themselves out of harm’s way by using ranged attacks, crowd control and healing abilities. 

Don’t enjoy being close to enemies and want allies to be at your mercy? Then Beko is your guy!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44969870/6b49e22e0e58af285b0c01bd645a8253abd2759c.gif[/img]

Whoever holds the lantern will get healed when enemies are slain close to them but will also function as a platform from which Beko can cast heals and push enemies!

What distinguishes a good from a great Beko player is not only the ability to keep yourself out of harm's way but also being able to keep track of who has the lantern and switching this up during a fight to make the most out of your abilities.

With Beko being a lot more squishier than Lotus and having higher healing values it can be a good idea to look for shards that boost survivability, boost the abilities of your allies - or go crazy and turn healing into damage, the choice is yours!

Compare this to Lotus, our take on a paladin arch-type, who heals by being part of the action and you get two completely different takes on playing a support within the game!
